verdict.rationale: Datalab explicitly offers an Enterprise on-prem/self-hosted deployment where customers run the models on infrastructure they control, including air-gapped operation, with a Helm chart for Kubernetes deployment and container-based on-prem running instructions. This directly satisfies the data-engineer's need to keep documents within their own VPC/infrastructure. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of a successful self-hosted deployment, and more detail on VPC-specific networking/configuration beyond Enterprise contract terms.
